originalTitle: Global Market: Samsung, SK Hynix rebound as bargain buying offsets AI chip selloff fears
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in simple terms: Samsung and SK Hynix are two big companies that make computer chips. Their stock prices went down at first, but then they went back up because some investors thought they were a good deal at the lower price. This happened even though some people were worried that new AI chips might hurt their business. The rebound was also helped by expectations that there won't be enough memory chips to meet demand, which could be good for these companies. Despite this, some experts think that the prices of these chips might not keep going up as much later in 2026.

originalTitle: Airtel to Trent: 44 stocks likely to report double-digit profit slump in Q1. Are your stocks on the list?
simplifiedContent: A company called Motilal Oswal thinks that 44 big companies, including well-known ones like Bharti Airtel and Cipla, will make a lot less profit in the April to June period compared to last year. This means their profits will likely go down by 10% or more. The reason for this expected decline is because of higher costs for energy, less demand for their products, and other global issues that are affecting businesses. This is important because it can impact the stock prices of these companies, which in turn can affect the investments of people who own shares in them. Overall, it seems like the first quarter of the year might be a tough time for many companies, with slower profit growth expected.

originalTitle: Eternal, ICICI Bank & 8 stocks with up to 27% upside. Do you own them?

originalTitle: ₹2 lakh crore gone! Why is the Indian stock market falling today? Explained with top five reasons
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market is currently experiencing a big drop, with ₹2 lakh crore being lost. This means that the overall value of the stocks in the market has decreased by a significant amount. The main reasons for this drop are the increasing tension between the US and Iran, as well as the rising prices of crude oil. These global events are affecting not just the Indian market, but also markets around the world. As a result, investors are selling their stocks, causing the market to fall.

originalTitle: Penny stock under  ₹10 PC Jeweller jumps 5% despite stock market sell-off
simplifiedContent: PC Jeweller is a very low-priced stock that recently went up in value by 5-6% despite the overall stock market going down. This happened after the company announced that it had paid back all the money it owed to two banks, which is a big accomplishment. This means that PC Jeweller is now closer to having no debts, which is a good thing for the company. This news is important because it shows that the company is making progress in getting its finances in order, which could make investors more confident in the stock. As a result, the stock price increased, which is a positive sign for the company and its investors.
